seed: Edit > Transform > Skew, Distort and Keystone at Next defaults with no flag changed. A busy screenshot is dropped and picked. Edit > Transform > Keystone puts its grips in Skew & distort, and a plain corner drag, no Shift, keystones: the corner across the top mirrors it. Escape steps back to Size, and Edit > Transform > Distort puts the grips back in Skew & distort, where a plain corner drag moves only that corner. The menu bar is only live with the app in front, so this walk takes the front.

steps.note: Keystone from the menu made a plain corner drag keystone; after Escape, Distort from the menu made a plain corner drag move only its own corner
